title: Module 9: Future Tense (will, be going to)

questions.question: Which sentence is a prediction based on present evidence?

options.B: Look at those clouds! It is going to rain.
options.D: I think it will rain tomorrow.

questions.trap: Semua opsi adalah prediksi, tapi dasarnya berbeda.
questions.explanation: Ada bukti terlihat sekarang (awan gelap) = be going to. 'I think...' = opini = will.

questions.question: Which sentence is a prediction based on opinion?

options.A: We have booked the tickets to Bali.
options.B: I think the exam will be hard.
options.D: Look at his face! He is going to cry.

questions.trap: 'going to' juga prediksi, tapi berdasarkan bukti.
questions.explanation: Opini/perkiraan pribadi = will.

questions.question: Which is a spontaneous decision made at the moment of speaking?

options.A: I have decided to get a new phone.
options.B: He is going to call me.
options.C: The phone is ringing. I'll get it.
options.D: I'm going to get a new phone next week.

questions.explanation: Keputusan saat berbicara = will. Keputusan sebelumnya = be going to.

questions.question: Which sentence shows a plan made before speaking?

options.A: I'm going to start a bug bounty blog next month.

questions.explanation: Niat yang sudah diputuskan sebelum berbicara = be going to.

questions.question: Which sentence shows a promise?

options.A: I am going to bed now.
options.B: I won't tell anyone your password.

questions.explanation: Janji = will / won't.

questions.question: 'She will ___ the report tomorrow.'
questions.explanation: will selalu diikuti base form tanpa -s.

questions.question: 'She is going to ___ abroad.'
questions.trap: 'to' membuat orang mengira verb berikutnya bentuk to-infinitive.
questions.explanation: be going to + base form (study).

questions.question: Which is correct?

options.A: They going to launch the app in June.
options.B: They are going to launch the app in June.
options.C: They is going to launch the app in June.
options.D: They are going launch the app in June.

questions.trap: Bentuk be hilang atau tidak cocok dengan subjek.
questions.explanation: Struktur lengkap: subjek + be (am/is/are) + going to + base form.

questions.question: ___ you going to attend the workshop?
questions.trap: 'Will' dikira satu-satunya pembentuk pertanyaan masa depan.
questions.explanation: be going to: kata kerja be dipindah ke depan (Are you going to...).

questions.question: 'Will you join us?' 'Yes, ___.'
questions.trap: Jawaban 'I do' mengikuti pola present simple.
questions.explanation: Jawaban singkat mengulang auxiliary: Yes, I will.

questions.question: 'Will' is followed by ___.
questions.trap: 'to' sering muncul setelah modal di bahasa Indonesia ('akan untuk').
questions.explanation: Modal will + base form tanpa 'to'.

questions.question: I will call you when I ___ home.
questions.trap: 'will get' terdengar logis karena masa depan.
questions.explanation: Setelah when/after/as soon as/before, masa depan dinyatakan dengan present simple.

questions.question: If you need help, I ___ you.
questions.explanation: Klausa utama dalam first conditional memakai will + base form.

questions.question: Which sentence shows a fixed arrangement with a time?

options.C: I am meeting my supervisor at 3 pm tomorrow.

questions.explanation: Present continuous + waktu mendatang menandai janji/atur jadwal yang sudah pasti.

questions.question: The class ___ at 8 am tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Jadwal/timetable tetap memakai present simple walau di masa depan.

questions.question: Which sentence is incorrect?

options.A: She is going to go to Bali.
options.B: She will not go to Bali.

questions.explanation: will tidak pernah diikuti verb ber-s: will goes salah.

questions.question: Which sentence expresses an offer?

options.B: Your bag looks heavy. I'll carry it.
options.C: I'm going to carry my bag.
options.D: My bag is going to be heavy.

questions.explanation: Tawaran spontan = will (I'll).

questions.question: Which sentence expresses strong certainty?
questions.explanation: 'I'm sure' menyatakan keyakinan tinggi. Perhaps/might/may menyatakan kemungkinan.

questions.question: In 'If you finish early, we will leave', which clause is dependent?
questions.explanation: 'If' menjadikan 'If you finish early' dependent. 'we will leave' = independent.

questions.question: 'will' in 'She will leave' is a ___.
questions.explanation: Di sini 'will' mendahului verb dan menandai masa depan = modal (auxiliary) verb.

questions.question: We ___ visit Malang, but it rained.
questions.explanation: Rencana masa lalu yang tidak terlaksana = was/were going to.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the wrong tense in the time clause?

options.A: When she arrives, I will call.
options.B: I will call you when I arrive.
options.C: As soon as it ends, I'll call.
options.D: I will call you when I will arrive.

questions.trap: 'will arrive' tampak benar karena masa depan.
questions.explanation: Time clause memakai present simple: 'when I arrive'.

questions.question: Which 'going to' is a future marker?

options.A: I am going to study tonight.
options.B: I am going to the library now.

questions.trap: 'going' pada 'going to the library' juga terdengar masa depan.
questions.explanation: 'going to study' = rencana (future). 'going to the library' = bergerak ke tempat.

questions.question: Which sentence is a compound sentence about the future?

options.A: I will study tonight, and I will take the exam tomorrow.
options.B: When I finish, I will rest.

questions.trap: 'When I finish' tampak seperti satu pola yang sama.
questions.explanation: Compound = dua independent clause dengan 'and'.

questions.question: In 'The team will fix the bug', what is the VP and its head?

options.C: will fix the bug; head: fix

questions.explanation: VP = will fix the bug; HEAD = main verb 'fix'.
